lines: I'm married, can I still use it?
People might start looking at you differently, and that's because darkening your eyebrows can actually help frame your face, making everything look a little more symmetrical and, guess what?
You just need a little grooming secret.
I saw that darkening eyebrows is one of those makeup tricks used to give celebrities like Robert Pattinson a more defined look.
It really makes your eyes POP.
And with this sweat- and water-resistant MenPen, you can fill in your eyebrows, mustache, and beard using this super thin tip, then blend everything out with the brush on the other side.
I bought ONE and received TWO!
Apparently, they've got that deal going on right now.
So if you're interested, I'll leave the link right down below for you.
